MDCS.title: Minimal Digital Chaotic System (MDCS)
MDCS.eq: x<sub>k+1</sub> = r · x<sub>k</sub> · x̄<sub>k</sub>,   x̄<sub>k</sub> = 1 − 2<sup>−n</sup> − x<sub>k</sub>  (digit complement)
MDCS.params: r = 4; unsigned fixed point, n fractional bits (Q0.n)
MDCS.impl: XOR-pair partial products (x<sub>i</sub>x̄<sub>j</sub> + x<sub>j</sub>x̄<sub>i</sub> = x<sub>i</sub> ⊕ x<sub>j</sub>), column compression, truncated to 2 guard columns with a bias constant; ×4 is wiring.
metrics: circuit max 2.5×10⁻¹⁹ (≈ 4.6 ulp of 2⁻⁶⁴); float64 max 1.37×10⁻¹⁶
0.0031 against float64 (noise floor 0.0019); 0.0026 against the exact arcsine density
MDCS.note: The 64-bit circuit is more precise than float64 (53-bit mantissa), so its one-step difference from float64 is dominated by float64’s own rounding. Runs: 10⁵ iterations after a 10³-step transient.
MDCS.ref: Nepomuceno, E. G., Lima, A. M., Arias-García, J., Perc, M., & Repnik, R. (2019). Minimal digital chaotic system. Chaos, Solitons & Fractals, 120, 62–66.
